integrity: Algebra and exact roots are reproducible with the included standalone verifier; numerical samples do not constitute a proof. Public-source comparisons are nonexhaustive. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Autonomous constant resident-exposure weight; unvaccinated two-city model; linear invasion threshold only. The fully commuting endpoint is only a continuous matrix limit; the nonlinear model is undefined there. Related 2023 dissertation inaccessible for complete comparison.
title: Unimodal commuter reproduction threshold with a sharp day–night transition
